findings.title: Undocumented file outside files_touched
findings.detail: launchSettings.json (23 lines) is in the staged diff but appears in neither the WI files_touched list nor the developer's files_changed / 6-deviation list. It is a harmless auto-generated dev-run profile, but it is a 7th, undocumented deviation. Content is benign (dev http/https profiles, ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development).
findings.recommendation: Either add it to the developer's deviation list with a one-line rationale, or leave as-is and note it here. No code change required.

findings.title: Serilog reads a non-existent config section; Logging section is dead for Serilog
findings.detail: Program.cs calls cfg.ReadFrom.Configuration(ctx.Configuration), which binds a 'Serilog' section, but neither appsettings.json nor appsettings.Development.json defines one — they only carry a 'Logging' section (Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, unused once Serilog is the host logger). Consequence: appsettings.Development.json 'Default: Debug' has no effect and Serilog stays at its default (Information). Not an AC violation, but the Logging section is misleading config a later WI can trip on.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Serilog' MinimumLevel section, or drop the ineffective Logging LogLevel overrides, so the intended dev log level is actually applied.

findings.title: Deviation 6 rationale is technically inaccurate (outcome fine)
findings.detail: The developer's deviation 6 states AspNetCore.HealthChecks.NpgSql 9.0.0 'brings a transitive Npgsql 8.0.3 alongside EF Core's Npgsql 10.0.3'. NuGet unifies transitive versions to the highest resolved (10.0.3); there is no side-by-side load. The health check runs against the unified Npgsql 10.0.3.
findings.recommendation: Accept the deviation; correct the note to 'NuGet unifies Npgsql to 10.0.3'.

findings.title: WI-13 SignalR query-token handling landed early
findings.detail: JwtBearerEvents.OnMessageReceived pulls access_token from the query string for /hubs paths — WI-13 functionality landing in WI-01. Acceptable: Program.cs is in files_touched, SignalR registration is a WI-01 AC, and the block is inert until a hub is mapped (MapHub deferred to WI-13).
findings.recommendation: No action. Ensure WI-13 does not duplicate this handler.

findings.title: Placeholder test retained (deviation 3) — removal owed in WI-02
findings.detail: A trivial passing placeholder test is kept to sidestep the xunit.v3 zero-tests non-zero-exit behavior. Accepted as documented. It must be removed when the real WI-02 harness lands.

summary: WI-01 meets every acceptance criterion: build -warnaserror 0/0 (re-run), tests green (re-run). Program.cs wiring complete and rule-compliant (Send.OkAsync pattern, DontCatchExceptions, feature-configuration Swagger tagging proven). Security pass clean: committed secrets are empty strings with fail-fast guards; dev-only values scoped to Development files/compose. All 6 documented deviations accepted; two carry inaccurate rationale (I-02, I-03) and one undocumented 7th deviation found (I-01). All findings minor/info; blocks_merge=false.
